svg.title: Sine envelope at six knob positions
svg.desc: Small multiples of the envelope amplitude over time for knob positions 0, 25, 50, 50, 75 and 100 percent.
svg.text: Sine envelope at six knob positions
Amplitude over time. Grey band = key held; dashed line = key released.
Pluck / bell — fades out on its own, key-up damps it
Organ → pad — holds while pressed, attack and fade grow
